title: Bug: [Validation][E5009] bp_interface IPs span multiple subnets (topology=t1-isolated-d448u16)
author: r12f
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

- ERROR: [E5009] multiple_subnets: bp_interface IPs span multiple subnets (topology=t1-isolated-d448u16, subnets=['10.10.246.0/24', '10.10.247.0/24'], subnet_count=2)

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the following command:

```
python3 ansible/scripts/meta/meta_validator.py -q -c .azure-pipelines/meta_validator.yml -r errors
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Validation should pass.
